name: Climbing Jasmine Ear Cuff
line: A single wire of hand-worked gold climbs the ear in a line of jasmine blossoms, each centred on a seed pearl.

name: Panja Hand Harness
line: A wrist band, a floral medallion and a trio of finger rings are joined by fine bead-chain, after antique panja harnesses.

name: Dragonfly Filigree Brooch
line: Openwork wings of gold wire frame a segmented emerald-and-gold body, pinned with a single ruby fleck at the tail.

name: Garden Pearl Pendant
line: A central pearl sits within a ring of chased petals, hung from a short festoon of bead-chain.

name: Leaf Repoussé Kada
line: A rounded gold kada, its face worked with a procession of repoussé leaves and studded with small pearls.

name: Blossom Jhumka
line: A pair of bell-shaped drops, each crowned with a small blossom and fringed with pearls on fine gold stems.
